Package model.animal

Class Animal

java.lang.Object
model.animal.Animal
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Identifiable
public class Animal extends Object implements Identifiable, Serializable
Description: Represents an animal in the zoo system, storing its details, status, and calculating food costs.

    • Animal

      public Animal(String animalId, String name, String specie, GenderType gender, double weight, DietType dietType, EnvironmentType requiereEnvironment, LifeStage lifeStage, HealthStatus healthStatus)
      Description: Constructs a new Animal object with its attributes and initial status.
      Parameters:
      animalId - Unique identifier code for the animal.
      name - Name of the animal.
      specie - Species of the animal.
      gender - Gender of the animal.
      weight - Weight of the animal.
      dietType - DietType enum constant.
      requiereEnvironment - EnvironmentType enum constant required by the animal.
      lifeStage - LifeStage enum constant.
      healthStatus - HealthStatus enum constant.
      status - AnimalStatusType enum constant. Precondition: Parameters must be valid and non-null for reference types. Postcondition: An Animal instance is created with all provided attributes initialized.

    • calculateMonthlyFoodCost

      public double calculateMonthlyFoodCost()
      Description: Calculates the monthly food cost for the animal based on its diet, weight, life stage, and health status.
      Returns:
      The calculated monthly food cost as a double. Precondition: Animal must have valid weight, diet type, life stage, and health status. Postcondition: Computes and returns the monthly feeding cost.
